motored.disclosure: Related party. Motored.lt is founder-linked. The 1,440 event wallets were generated by Token Tails (keys held by Token Tails), 480 per round, labelled user-1..user-480. They are not Motored customers and not separate donors; gift amounts followed a random schedule to show live activity. On Arc, 100% of the Motored funder's USDC came from founder wallet 0x29d7 (relatedTxs motored-funder-topup); any reimbursement by Motored happened off-chain and cannot be verified here. Count the whole bucket as one related party.

motoredPayers.note: Per-wallet rows omitted for size; every payout row carries its payer.

motoredReconciliation.note: Per-wallet check for all event wallets: funding from the funder (Transfer logs), gifts out (payouts), and balance and nonce at toBlock (eth_getBalance, eth_getTransactionCount). impliedGas = funded - donated - balance; if any wallet had received money from anyone but the funder, it would show as more out than in or as implausible gas. finalLeftoverPayouts are the odd-amount "-final" gifts that gave away leftover balance, on top of the planned schedule.

fundingOrigin.note: Every payer, and every Token Tails or Motored address its money came through, walked upstream on Arc (dust spam ignored).
fundingOrigin.conclusion: 100% of the payout USD traces on Arc to founder wallet 0x29d7: it paid directly, funded the deployer (which funded donateHot and the proof payouts), and topped up the Motored funder (which funded every event wallet). One controlling party: Token Tails / the founder (Motored is the founder-linked).

payoutColumnsNote: amount is a float at full precision (native USDC has 18 decimals), so a sum of rows can differ from totals.usd in the last digits; totals come from exact integer sums (totals.usdExact).

eth_getTransactionCount at toBlock: every tx each wallet ever sent on Arc mainnet, including ones that left no log (gas-only calls). txsInThisLedger counts the distinct txs this ledger shows for the wallet. Every sent tx is shown in this ledger. Motored event wallets summed; their nonces equal their payouts (motoredReconciliation).

caveats: Arc mainnet only (chainId 5042). Payouts are inflows to the campaign shelter wallet that was the payee at that block (campaign.json): 0xE299 for blocks 23790973-26229681 (Token Tails-held), then Pink Paw wallet 0x3c83. The 0xE299 -> 0x3c83 sweep on the rotation day is listed in relatedTxs as internal, not as a payout.
Native USDC on Arc moves are logged by the system address 0xff..fe at 18 decimals; ERC-20 calls on 0x3600 are logged there at 6 decimals. Both are read; a move logged twice in one tx is counted once.

The public RPC no longer serves receipts or tx lookups for older hashes (the recorded deploy tx receipts return null), so tx senders come from full blocks and deploy blocks from the first contract event.
Payer = RouterDonation donor (the EIP-3009 signer) for router gifts, DisbursementBatch payer (msg.sender of disburse/donate) for split gifts, Transfer sender for direct transfers.

Funding trace is one hop plus "received money from a Token Tails or Motored wallet on Arc". Money bridged in through CCTP or a CEX shows as a mint/transfer from an address outside the inventory; such a payer is only "outside" if no Token Tails or Motored link was found. A founder-controlled wallet that is not in the inventory cannot be detected from chain data alone.

Crypto-checkout Pink Paw shares and Moon Rave card orders (memo tt:rave, split-disburse) are paid by donateHot (Token Tails) through the split, so they are tt-self even when a real card buyer may sit behind them off-chain; that buyer is not verified here (buckets.tt-self.byKind). Customer payments into the treasury are listed separately as treasury-inflow-external.
Motored x Stripe customer wallets are created at runtime and not listed publicly; any wallet funded by the Motored funder lands in funded-by-tt-or-motored through the funding trace.

Gas-only transactions (contract calls with no value and no event, failed txs) leave no log; only their counts are known, from eth_getTransactionCount per wallet (relatedAggregates eoa-sent-tx-counts).
USD totals count USDC at $1. EURC is reported separately in eurc and not converted.
